0x10032e85.name: cmd_setoutfit

(CiroScript 'setoutfit', doc 11)

0x10032f46.name: cmd_setitemoutfit
0x10032f46.purpose: CiroScript handler that resolves a creature record (g_1005f7ed or by name via sub_100399af) and a numeric value via sub_10040900 bounded to 100..10477 (0x64..0x28ed), clearing field_60 and storing the value in field_64 - a per-creature distance/range setting. (CiroScript 'setitemoutfit', doc 11)

0x10032fb1.name: cmd_setrelation
0x10032fb1.purpose: CiroScript handler that reads a creature name plus a mode arg (0..2), fetches a record via sub_100399af/sub_10023861, and sets its relation byte at +140 to 1/2/3/4 by matching the second string arg against "enemy", "subenemy", "friend", or "subfriend". (CiroScript 'setrelation', doc 11)

0x1003308d.name: cmd_setdebug
0x1003308d.purpose: CiroScript handler that reads one numeric arg via sub_100300ce and stores it into global g_100f931c (a bot config/mode value). (CiroScript 'setdebug', doc 11)

0x1003309e.name: cmd_getproperties
0x1003309e.purpose: CiroScript handler that reads a numeric arg, transforms it via sub_1003c4fa, formats both values with wsprintfA using "%lX %lX" and emits the resulting string through sub_10039374 (script output/echo). (CiroScript 'getproperties', doc 11)

0x100330d2.name: cmd_gettile
0x100330d2.purpose: CiroScript handler that reads three numeric args, computes a value via sub_1003a03f(a,b,c), formats it as "%lX" with wsprintfA and outputs it via sub_10039374. (CiroScript 'gettile', doc 11)

0x1003311b.name: cmd_goinvisible
0x1003311b.purpose: CiroScript handler that, when the current creature record g_1005f7ed is set and its field_60 flag is non-zero, casts the invisibility spell by sending "utana vid" through sub_10039413 (the say/cast channel). (CiroScript 'goinvisible', doc 11)

0x10033139.name: cmd_moveitems
0x10033139.purpose: CiroScript handler that reads a target id, resolves a path node via sub_10036daf, then loops issuing sub_100371fd (walk step) clearing g_100f49f9 each pass and, while g_100f0e42 (walking-enabled) is set, Sleep(300)s and retries until arrival - a walk-to-coordinate command with retry. (CiroScript 'moveitems', doc 11)

0x100331b4.name: cmd_movenitems
0x100331b4.purpose: CiroScript handler that reads two numeric args, resolves a path target via sub_10036daf and, unless it returns the -2 sentinel, issues a single walk step via sub_100371fd (a fire-and-forget go-to variant of sub_10033139). (CiroScript 'movenitems', doc 11)

0x100331ed.name: cmd_moveitemsonto
0x100331ed.purpose: CiroScript handler reading three numeric args (x, y, count) that resolves a tile via sub_10036daf and loops sub_10037384 (use-on-tile), clearing g_100f49f5, and while g_100f0e42 is set Sleep(300)s/Sleep(500)s retrying up to the count, incrementing on each miss - a use-item-on-tile command with repeat. (CiroScript 'moveitemsonto', doc 11)

0x100332b7.name: cmd_openitem
0x100332b7.purpose: CiroScript handler that reads two numeric args, resolves a tile via sub_10036daf and issues a single sub_10037100 (use action) on it - a one-shot use-on-tile variant. (CiroScript 'openitem', doc 11)

0x100332e9.name: cmd_openbpitem
0x100332e9.purpose: Builds a client->server packet in the g_100434d7 buffer with opcode 3, reads a session word from *0x64ccb0 into g_100434da and a byte from sub_10038d20, sets length 12 and flushes it via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'openbpitem', doc 11)

0x10033325.name: cmd_openbeltitem
0x10033325.purpose: Builds a client->server packet in the g_100434d7 buffer with opcode 0x0A (10), reads a session word from *0x64cd04 into g_100434da and a byte from sub_10038d20, sets length 12 and flushes it via sub_1002ade7 - a sibling of sub_100332e9 with a different opcode. (CiroScript 'openbeltitem', doc 11)

0x10033361.name: cmd_closeallwindows
0x10033361.purpose: Iterates the 16 container slots (492-byte stride from base 6606096/0x64cd10), and for each open container (non-null first field) queues a 4-byte script/packet record (tag 8847362) via sub_1002ade7 carrying the slot index. (CiroScript 'closeallwindows', doc 11)

0x100333bb.name: cmd_reopenwindows
0x100333bb.purpose: Same 16-container 492-byte-stride flush loop as sub_10033361 emitting tag-8847362 records via sub_1002ade7, then resets bot state: clears g_100f9318, sets g_100f45bc=6 and g_100f9326=1 (reinitializing the container/looter subsystem). (CiroScript 'reopenwindows', doc 11)

0x1003342d.name: cmd_loadcavebot
0x1003342d.purpose: One-line CiroScript command thunk that just calls sub_10030225 (the arg/token consumer/state reset helper) and returns; wraps that single helper. (CiroScript 'loadcavebot', doc 11)

0x1003343e.name: cmd_loadtargeting
0x1003343e.purpose: Identical single-call thunk to sub_10030225 (arg/token consumer helper), one of a series of near-duplicate command dispatch stubs. (CiroScript 'loadtargeting', doc 11)

0x1003344f.name: cmd_loadsetting
0x1003344f.purpose: Another duplicate command stub that only invokes sub_10030225 and returns; a distinct opcode entry sharing the same handler body. (CiroScript 'loadsetting', doc 11)

0x10033460.name: cmd_loadscript
0x10033460.purpose: Duplicate command stub calling only sub_10030225; distinct dispatch-table slot with the same trivial body. (CiroScript 'loadscript', doc 11)

0x10033471.name: cmd_openitemnew
0x10033471.purpose: CiroScript command that reads two args via sub_100300ce, calls sub_10030225, then applies the second value through sub_10036daf and finalizes with sub_10037100 (a memory-write/config commit sequence). (CiroScript 'openitemnew', doc 11)

0x100334a6.name: cmd_useitemsonground
0x100334a6.purpose: Reads two coord/type triples (addr, size, flag via sub_100300ce), resolves each into pointers via sub_1003a065, tags them into the g_10043427 record block, checks type bytes with sub_1003c4fa (rejecting 0x30003000/536879112 and testing bit 0x10 to set g_10043439), then commits opcode 19 via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'useitemsonground', doc 11)

0x10033567.name: cmd_useongroundxyz
0x10033567.purpose: Reads a target plus a coord/type triple, resolves via sub_1003a065; if the resolved type equals 0x30003000/536879112 it falls back to sub_1002ae92 to store the raw value into g_10043419, else tests bit 0x10 to flag g_10043426, then commits opcode 19 to the g_10043414 record via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'useongroundxyz', doc 11)

0x10033619.name: cmd_repeatuseongroundxyz
0x10033619.purpose: Reads target/coord args then loops calling sub_1003a065 until the resolved address equals the expected value v2, writing opcode-19 records into g_10043414 each pass; between failed polls it Sleep(100)s up to 500ms while g_100f0e42 stays set and clears g_100f0e18, forming a wait-for-memory-state command. (CiroScript 'repeatuseongroundxyz', doc 11)

0x100336d9.name: cmd_useongrounditem
0x100336d9.purpose: Reads a target and an id, translates the id via sub_1002be32, stores it as the coord source with the global slot g_1005f85c as extra field, then follows the same sub_1003c4fa type check + sub_1002ae92 fallback and commits opcode 19 into g_10043414 record via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'useongrounditem', doc 11)

0x10033778.name: cmd_useoninventoryitem
0x10033778.purpose: Reads two args, scans a 10-entry/12-byte-stride table at 0x64 CB98 (6605976) for a slot whose first dword matches arg2, storing the matching index into the g_1004343a record, otherwise resolves via sub_1002ae92, then commits opcode 19 via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'useoninventoryitem', doc 11)

0x100337fd.name: cmd_useoncreature
0x100337fd.purpose: Clears g_100f9328, reads an arg, builds a 2032-byte(-offset) record via sub_10038eb3, populates the g_100432e5 block; when g_100fa4f0 is unset it stores the sub_1002ae92 raw value, else zeroes the fields, sets g_100f9328=1 and commits opcode 15 with the '\r' key via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'useoncreature', doc 11)

0x1003389f.name: cmd_eatfood
0x1003389f.purpose: Trivial command thunk that calls sub_1003867e and returns; wraps that single subsystem call. (CiroScript 'eatfood', doc 11)

0x100338a8.name: cmd_uhpc
0x100338a8.purpose: Variant of cmdBuildCreatureRecordAt2032: builds the sub_10038eb3 record but only commits when record field[0x22] < 3160, then fills the g_100432e5 block (raw sub_1002ae92 value or zeros depending on g_100fa4f0), sets g_100f9328 and commits opcode 15 via sub_1002ade7('\r'). (CiroScript 'uhpc', doc 11)

0x1003396b.name: cmd_soulf
0x1003396b.purpose: Clears g_100f9328, builds a record via sub_10038eb3, then scans the g_1008b7f3..g_1008b893 id table for a matching creature id (or empty slot, or one older than 20000ms via GetTickCount); on match stores id into g_1008b893, sets opcode 8/g_100f9328, and dispatches via sub_1003a60a, refreshing through sub_1003bc54/sub_1003bec5 per mode. (CiroScript 'soulf', doc 11)

0x10033a86.name: cmd_annisd
0x10033a86.purpose: Walks the client creature array (0x63fef8..0x64a308, 148-byte stride) for the nearest live entry named "Demon" (lstrcmpi) whose coords match g_1005f858/g_1005f85c, then invokes sub_1003a60a on it with action g_100f94cb and returns its id field_24 (attack-nearest-Demon command). (CiroScript 'annisd', doc 11)

0x10033b23.name: cmd_fish
0x10033b23.purpose: Consumes one arg via sub_100300ce then tail-calls sub_10037694, forwarding its result; thin command wrapper around that handler. (CiroScript 'fish', doc 11)

0x10033b38.name: cmd_safe
0x10033b38.purpose: If flag g_10080ba6 is clear, invokes sub_10030442 with three stack args and returns its result; gates a subsystem call on that global. (CiroScript 'safe', doc 11)

0x10033b53.name: cmd_filewrite
0x10033b53.purpose: Consumes two tokens via sub_10030225 then tail-calls sub_1002583e with the -2032/-0x1000 offset constants and 0; thin command wrapper forwarding to that handler. (CiroScript 'filewrite', doc 11)

0x1003442c.name: cmd_istargeting
0x1003442c.purpose: Conditional cast wrapper: if the boolean config flag g_100f0e20 is set, invokes the common action/packet dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args (target/spell context) and returns its result. (CiroScript 'istargeting', doc 11)

0x10034447.name: cmd_isnottargeting
0x10034447.purpose: Walks the creature/battle-list table (records at 0x63fef8..0x64a308, ~24-byte stride) and, when a slot is active (field[36]) and its id (field[11]) matches the selected target g_1005f85c, does a case-insensitive lstrcmpi name compare and fires the cast dispatcher sub_10030442; ensures the table is loaded first via sub_10030442/sub_10030225 when g_100f0e20 is clear. (CiroScript 'isnottargeting', doc 11)

0x100344ba.name: cmd_isnotonscreen
0x100344ba.purpose: Refreshes the creature table via sub_10030225 then scans records 0x63fef8..0x64a308 for an active slot whose id (field[11]) equals the selected target g_1005f85c and whose name matches via lstrcmpi; returns early on match, otherwise falls through to the cast dispatcher sub_10030442. (CiroScript 'isnotonscreen', doc 11)

0x1003451a.name: cmd_ifpoisoned
0x1003451a.purpose: Thin conditional wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7de is set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifpoisoned', doc 11)

0x10034535.name: cmd_ifdrunk
0x10034535.purpose: Thin conditional wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7df is set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifdrunk', doc 11)

0x10034550.name: cmd_ifhasted
0x10034550.purpose: Thin conditional wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7dc is set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifhasted', doc 11)

0x1003456b.name: cmd_ifparalyzed
0x1003456b.purpose: Thin conditional wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7dd is set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifparalyzed', doc 11)

0x10034586.name: cmd_ifnotparalyzed
0x10034586.purpose: Inverse-gated wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7dd is NOT set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifnotparalyzed', doc 11)

0x100345a1.name: cmd_ifnothasted
0x100345a1.purpose: Inverse-gated wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7dc is NOT set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifnothasted', doc 11)

0x100345bc.name: cmd_ifmanashielded
0x100345bc.purpose: Thin conditional wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7d9 is set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifmanashielded', doc 11)

0x100345d7.name: cmd_ifnotmanashielded
0x100345d7.purpose: Inverse-gated wrapper: if config flag g_1005f7d9 is NOT set, calls the cast/action dispatcher sub_10030442 with the three stack args and returns its result. (CiroScript 'ifnotmanashielded', doc 11)

0x100345f2.name: cmd_haste
0x100345f2.purpose: Auto-haste helper: unless config flag g_1005f7dc is set, sends the spell say 'utani hur' (light haste) via the spell/say dispatcher sub_10039413. (CiroScript 'haste', doc 11)

0x10034609.name: cmd_stronghaste
0x10034609.purpose: Auto-haste helper: unless config flag g_1005f7dc is set, sends the spell say 'utani gran hur' (strong haste) via sub_10039413. (CiroScript 'stronghaste', doc 11)

0x10034620.name: cmd_charge
0x10034620.purpose: Auto-haste helper: unless config flag g_1005f7dc is set, sends the knight/paladin haste spell 'utani tempo hur' via sub_10039413. (CiroScript 'charge', doc 11)

0x10034637.name: cmd_swiftfoot
0x10034637.purpose: Auto-buff helper: unless config flag g_1005f7dc is set, sends the paladin protection spell 'utamo tempo san' via sub_10039413. (CiroScript 'swiftfoot', doc 11)

0x1003464e.name: cmd_manashield
0x1003464e.purpose: Auto-magic-shield helper: when g_1005f7d9 is set it skips casting if mana-shield/soul counter g_1008b8dc is >=50 or ==0, otherwise sends the magic-shield spell 'utamo vita' via sub_10039413. (CiroScript 'manashield', doc 11)

0x10034677.name: cmd_ewave
0x10034677.purpose: Clears state flag g_100ee8dc then, when the value at 0x63fe78 (a player stat/coord) is >=250 and gate flag g_1008b8e8 is clear, invokes action sub_10024d66 returning its struct pointer. (CiroScript 'ewave', doc 11)

0x1003469d.name: cmd_wave
0x1003469d.purpose: Refreshes bot state via sub_10030225, then returns early if gate flag g_1008b8e8 is set, otherwise invokes action sub_10024d66 and returns its result. (CiroScript 'wave', doc 11)

0x10033b85.name: cmd_filewriteline
0x10033b85.purpose: CiroScript block handler that primes iteration state by calling sub_10030225 twice, then dispatches the loop body via sub_1002583e with mode arg 1 over the parser's local buffers. (CiroScript 'filewriteline', doc 11)

0x10033bb7.name: cmd_log
0x10033bb7.purpose: Thin CiroScript wrapper that calls sub_10030225 to advance the parser state then hands the current token buffer to sub_100252ba for evaluation. (CiroScript 'log', doc 11)

0x10033bd5.name: cmd_filedelete
0x10033bd5.purpose: Variant of sub_10033b85: advances parser state via sub_10030225 then dispatches the loop body through sub_1002583e with mode arg 2 instead of 1. (CiroScript 'filedelete', doc 11)

0x10033bfc.name: cmd_while
0x10033bfc.purpose: Bounded (max 1000) iteration loop: clears g_1008ab97 or g_1008ab93 depending on whether the sentinel arg is 0xffffffff, then per pass calls sub_100300ce, lstrcpy's the entry into the parse buffer, runs sub_10030442, and stops early when the match flag (g_1008ab97/g_100f0e30 or g_1008ab93) is set. (CiroScript 'while', doc 11)

0x10033c87.name: cmd_loop
0x10033c87.purpose: Count-bounded variant of sub_10033bfc: iterates i over the count returned by sub_100300ce (capped at 1000), copying each entry with lstrcpy and invoking sub_10030442, breaking early when the g_1008ab97/g_100f0e30 or g_1008ab93 match flag fires based on the 0xffffffff sentinel. (CiroScript 'loop', doc 11)

0x10033d17.name: cmd_foreach
0x10033d17.purpose: CiroScript $-prefixed creature-list selector: parses a named list into the g_100f49d1 512-byte-stride creature table (add/find by lstrcmpi), then maps selector keywords (allcreatures/allmonsters/allplayers/floor*/screen*/shootable* and newmessages) to filter tuples (monster flag, player flag, floor bound from g_1005f85c, screen/shootable mode 0/1/2). (CiroScript 'foreach', doc 11)

0x10034264.name: cmd_ifgm
0x10034264.purpose: Conditional CiroScript action: runs the body sub_10030442(v1,v2,v3) only when global flag g_100f49c9 is nonzero. (CiroScript 'ifgm', doc 11)

0x1003427f.name: cmd_ifnogm
0x1003427f.purpose: Inverse of sub_10034264: executes body sub_10030442 only when global flag g_100f49c9 is zero. (CiroScript 'ifnogm', doc 11)

0x1003429a.name: cmd_ifplayeronscreen
0x1003429a.purpose: Conditional CiroScript action: runs body sub_10030442 only when global flag g_100f49cd is nonzero. (CiroScript 'ifplayeronscreen', doc 11)

0x100342b5.name: cmd_ifnoplayeronscreen
0x100342b5.purpose: Inverse of sub_1003429a: executes body sub_10030442 only when global flag g_100f49cd is zero. (CiroScript 'ifnoplayeronscreen', doc 11)

0x100342d0.name: cmd_ifdefaultmessage
0x100342d0.purpose: Conditional CiroScript action: runs body sub_10030442 only when global flag g_1005f561 is nonzero. (CiroScript 'ifdefaultmessage', doc 11)

0x100342eb.name: cmd_ifprivatemessage
0x100342eb.purpose: Conditional CiroScript action: runs body sub_10030442 only when global flag g_1005f565 is nonzero. (CiroScript 'ifprivatemessage', doc 11)

0x10034306.name: cmd_ifplayerattacking
0x10034306.purpose: Conditional CiroScript action: runs body sub_10030442 only when global flag g_1005f569 is nonzero. (CiroScript 'ifplayerattacking', doc 11)

0x10034321.name: cmd_isposz
0x10034321.purpose: Conditional action: fetches a value via sub_100300ce and runs body sub_10030442 only when it matches the current floor global *g_1005f85c (returns without acting otherwise). (CiroScript 'isposz', doc 11)

0x10034341.name: cmd_istargetname
0x10034341.purpose: Resolves the selected/target creature id in g_1008b89b through sub_1003997e and sub_1003c23e, and if the resulting creature record has field_90 set and its name (at +4) matches the parsed argument via lstrcmpi, executes the body sub_10030442. (CiroScript 'istargetname', doc 11)

0x1003439c.name: cmd_isattackedname
0x1003439c.purpose: Same name-match conditional as sub_10034341 but keyed on the creature id stored at absolute global 0x63fe64: looks it up via sub_1003997e/sub_1003c23e and runs body sub_10030442 when the record's +4 name matches the argument (lstrcmpi). (CiroScript 'isattackedname', doc 11)

0x100343f4.name: cmd_isattacking
0x100343f4.purpose: Conditional action: runs body sub_10030442 only when the creature-id global at 0x63fe64 is nonzero (otherwise returns the global itself). (CiroScript 'isattacking', doc 11)

0x10034410.name: cmd_isnotattacking
0x10034410.purpose: Inverse of sub_100343f4: executes body sub_10030442 only when the global at 0x63fe64 is zero. (CiroScript 'isnotattacking', doc 11)

0x10032766.name: cmd_listboxaddline
0x10032766.purpose: Parses up to four script args via sub_100300ce (a 24-bit value assembled from 3 bytes) and writes into a 520-byte-stride ring of 32 timed-action slots (idx[6] wraps at 31), storing the packed value at slot+128 and a GetTickCount-derived fire time (tick + interval) at slot+129, seeding g_100f49f1 base offset. (CiroScript 'listboxaddline', doc 11)

0x10032803.name: cmd_setcolor
0x10032803.purpose: If the passed slot index isn't -1, indexes a 276-byte-stride record table at g_100ba736 and fills three consecutive fields (offsets 66/67/68 as uint) with three parsed script args from sub_100300ce. (CiroScript 'setcolor', doc 11)

0x1003284d.name: cmd_displaytext
0x1003284d.purpose: Guarded by slot index != -1: flushes pending state via sub_10030225 and sets the global mode flag g_100ee8b6 to 1. (CiroScript 'displaytext', doc 11)

0x1003287c.name: cmd_listas
0x1003287c.purpose: For a valid slot index, writes 3 into the 276-byte-stride record at g_100ba736[276*idx], flushes via sub_10030225, and sets global mode g_100ee8b6 to 3. (CiroScript 'listas', doc 11)

0x100328af.name: cmd_dontlist
0x100328af.purpose: If the slot index isn't -1, sets the global mode flag g_100ee8b6 to 2 (no flush, unlike the mode-1/mode-3 variants). (CiroScript 'dontlist', doc 11)

0x100328c7.name: cmd_sio
0x100328c7.purpose: Builds an 'exura sio "<name>' self/targeted heal spell string: clears g_100f9328, resolves a record via sub_10038eb3, and when the record's name field fits, lstrcpy/lstrcat's the spell prefix with the target name and dispatches it via sub_10039413, gated by g_10080ba6 mode. (CiroScript 'sio', doc 11)

0x1003295a.name: cmd_usegrounditem
0x1003295a.purpose: Reads a script arg and a coord word (v2), runs sub_1002be32 on the parsed id, and populates the attack/use packet header block at g_100433ff (id, coord, g_1005f85c stack byte, flags=1) then emits a 12-byte packet via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'usegrounditem', doc 11)

0x100329a7.name: cmd_opengrounditem
0x100329a7.purpose: Flushes state, resolves the currently-selected item id via sub_10036daf + sub_1002be32, fills the use-packet header at g_100433ff (embedding a stack buffer pointer, g_1005f85c stack, and a mode from sub_10038d20), and sends a 12-byte packet via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'opengrounditem', doc 11)

0x10032a08.name: cmd_playsound
0x10032a08.purpose: Flushes pending packet state via sub_10030225 then hands the on-stack command buffer to sub_1000954e for dispatch. (CiroScript 'playsound', doc 11)

0x10032a26.name: cmd_useitem
0x10032a26.purpose: Fills the second packet-header block at g_1004340b with a fixed 0xffff item id, zeroed coords, a parsed coord word (sub_100300ce), and flags=1, then sends a 12-byte packet via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'useitem', doc 11)

0x10032a6b.name: cmd_usegroundxyz
0x10032a6b.purpose: Reads three script args (item id, x, y) into g_100433ff header fields, resolves a target/tile via sub_1003a065, and on success sets flags=1 and emits a 12-byte packet via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'usegroundxyz', doc 11)

0x10032acb.name: cmd_opengroundxyz
0x10032acb.purpose: Same as sub_10032a6b (three args -> sub_1003a065 target resolve -> g_100433ff header -> 12-byte sub_1002ade7 packet) but takes the trailing mode byte from sub_10038d20 instead of a hardcoded 1. (CiroScript 'opengroundxyz', doc 11)

0x10032b2e.name: cmd_reachgrounditem
0x10032b2e.purpose: Flushes state, resolves selected item via sub_10036daf, then loops on sub_100374ba: while the result is 2 and slot index is -1 and g_100f0e42 is set, Sleeps 300ms and clears g_100f0e18, effectively polling/retrying until the action completes. (CiroScript 'reachgrounditem', doc 11)

0x10032b80.name: cmd_skin
0x10032b80.purpose: Resolves a target via sub_100377cb, sets g_100f0dfc length to 12, fills the 19-byte move/throw packet header at g_10043414 with opcode 5908, target id, coord word, g_1005f85c stack, and sets a flag if sub_1003c4fa returns bit 0x10, then sends via sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'skin', doc 11)

0x10032bf6.name: cmd_stake
0x10032bf6.purpose: Identical to sub_10032b80 but uses opcode 5942 in the 19-byte packet header at g_10043414 (a sibling move/throw variant) resolved via sub_100377cb and sent through sub_1002ade7. (CiroScript 'stake', doc 11)

0x10032c6c.name: cmd_moveto

0x1002e9fa.name: cmd_hp
